City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 10, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CONSENT CALENDAR
1.

2.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10B): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 11/12/2014 Special Meeting and the 11/12/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-12-10 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-12-10 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance 2014-12 amending Encinitas Municipal Code. Contact Person: Administrative Support Coordinator Morrow.
Adopt Ordinance 2014-12 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapters 2.28 Cabinet Team Positions and Officers; 2.40 Traffic and Public Safety Commission; 14.08 Traffic Administration; 14.41 Permit Parking Zones; 15.04 Construction on Public Rights-of-Way; 18.08 Sewer Connection Fees; 23.24 Grading Erosion and Sediment Control; 23.36 Right-of-Way Standards, Street Improvement Standards, and Building Line Requirements; 23.40 Floodplain Management Regulations; 30.48 Accessory Use Regulations."
2014-12-10 Item 8C - Adoption of Ordinance 2014-12
8D.
Amendment to contract for development of the Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center Design. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Deane
1) Authorize the Director of Public Works to approve an amendment to the contract with Stephen Dalton Architects and to award contracts to other consultants as may be necessary to facilitate the development of environmental, preliminary design, and construction documents for the Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center in a total amount not to exceed $282,800; and 2) Provide direction to staff regarding contract amendment supplemental services for the development of building alternatives and/or for pursuit of a formal LEED certification, and increase accordingly the total amount for design and plan development.
2014-12-10 Item 8D - Amendment to Contract for Development of Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center Design
8E.
Acceptance of public improvements for the Manchester Avenue Culvert Repair Project (CX11G) and authorization to record a Notice of Completion. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Accept the public improvements for the Manchester Avenue Culvert Repair Project (CX11G); and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2014-12-10 Item 8E - Manchester Avenue Culvert Repair
8F.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of-way located at 834-836 DeWitt Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-61 approving the summary vacation of a portion of Dewitt Avenue right-of-way fronting the property at 834-836 Dewitt Avenue.
2014-12-10 Item 8F - DeWitt Avenue Summary Vacation
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
This appeal has been removed and only appears on the agenda because it has been noticed. Public hearing of an appeal filed by Allan Jaffe, on behalf of the Garden View Court Maintenance Association, regarding the payment of Traffic Mitigation Fees required as part of Building and Planning Department's approval of a Minor Use Permit (MIN) to allow for the conversion of existing general office space into medical office space parking pursuant to section 30.54.020K of the Encinitas Municipal Code. The project is located within the Office Professional (OP) zone in the community of New Encinitas in the City of Encinitas. CASE NUMBER: 14-131 MIN. FILING DATE: November 3, 2014. LOCATION: 700 Garden View Court (APN 257-470-28). APPLICANT: Garden Maintenance Association. APPELLANT: Garden View Court Maintenance Association. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Deane. This appeal has been removed and only appears on the agenda because it has been noticed.
10B.
Council to meet with applicants to fill an unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (at-large representative) with a term ending March 2016 and to fill one vacancy on the Senior Citizen Commission with a term ending March 2017. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on the commissions.
2014-12-10 Item 10B - Traffic and Public Safety and Senior Commission Unscheduled Vacancy
10C.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Minor Use Permit and Coastal Development Permit to allow a small animal hospital and the keeping of animals with medical needs overnight at an existing veterinarian use. The project site is located within the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan Commercial-Mixed 1 (N-CM-1) zone and the Coastal Zone in the community of Leucadia. CASE NUMBER: 13-227 MIN/CDP; APPLICANT: Coast Animal Hospital; APPELLANT: Robert Aronin on behalf of the Leucadia Neighbors; LOCATION: 434 North Coast Highway 101 (APN: 256-272-11). Contact Person: Associate Planner: Mierau
Deny the appeal and adopt attached Draft Resolution No. 2014-68 affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the Minor Use Permit and Coastal Development Permit application, thus allowing a small animal hospital and the keeping of animals with medical needs overnight at an existing veterinarian use for the reasons outlined under the analysis section of this report. Alternative options are also provided in the analysis section.
2014-12-10 Item 10C - Coast Animal Hospital Appeal
10D.
Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive traffic safety/calming improvements. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Blough
1) Install a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) pedestrian activated crosswalk with the necessary signs, markings and street improvements on Saxony Road near the YMCA; 2) Install a RRFB pedestrian activated crosswalk with the necessary signs, markings and street improvements on Quail Gardens Drive in the vicinity of Ecke Ranch Road; 3) Install two Vehicle Speed Feedback Signs (VSFS) in each direction on Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive, a total of eight signs. The signs would be located in advance of the RRFB crosswalks as well as other logical locations along the roadways; 4) Perform a new Traffic and Engineering Speed Zone Survey after the RRFB crosswalks and VSFS have been installed. This survey would determine if the 85th percentile speeds have been reduced to a level where the speed limit can be legally posted at a lower limit.
2014-12-10 Item 10D - Saxony & Quail Gardens Traffic Calming Improvements
10E.
Review and Discussion of Appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards, Commissions, and Committees. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Receive the information.
2014-12-10 Item 10E - Council Committee & Board Appointments

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
